features.name: norm_v1_v2_ratio
features.description: Ratio of V1 to V2, normalized by a small constant to prevent division by zero, providing a scale-invariant feature for distance calculations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Improves KNN performance by providing a normalized relative scale between two continuous descriptors, reducing the impact of absolute magnitude.

features.name: distance_to_global_mean_v8_v15
features.description: Euclidean distance to the unsupervised global mean of features V8 and V15, acting as a prototype-distance feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps the distance-based model capture the geometric position of a sample relative to the center of the data distribution.

features.name: v30_v31_interaction_score
features.description: Log-scaled interaction between V30 and V31 to compress the long tail and provide a stable similarity metric.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the influence of extreme values in distance calculations by applying a log transformation to the product of two continuous features.

features.name: structural_complexity_index
features.description: Sum of several integer count features (V3, V5, V7, V9, V11) representing overall structural complexity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates sparse count features into a single dense dimension, improving the density of the neighborhood geometry.

features.name: v12_deviation_from_zero
features.description: Absolute deviation of V12 from zero, capturing the magnitude of this descriptor regardless of sign.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a symmetric distance metric for V12, which is useful if the magnitude is more important than the direction.

features.name: v36_v39_similarity
features.description: Absolute difference between V36 and V39, acting as an internal similarity score between two continuous descriptors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the KNN model to group samples that have similar relative values for V36 and V39.

features.name: high_density_region_indicator
features.description: Indicator feature that is 1 if the sample falls within a high-density region defined by the means of V1 and V2.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a soft cluster assignment, helping the KNN model distinguish between typical and atypical samples in the feature space.

features.name: v15_normalized_deviation
features.description: Z-score-like normalization of V15 using its training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes the scale of V15, ensuring it contributes proportionally to the Euclidean distance metric.

features.name: molecular_size_proxy
features.description: Linear combination of V8 and V30, serving as a proxy for overall molecular size or weight.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a dominant axis of variation that can help align the distance metric with a major physical property.

features.name: v17_v18_ratio
features.description: Ratio of V17 to V18, capturing the relative proportion of these two tightly bounded continuous features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights subtle structural differences that might be obscured by the absolute values of V17 and V18.

features.name: semantic_cluster_assignment
features.description: An unsupervised cluster assignment based on the overall molecular descriptor profile, assigning the molecule to one of 5 distinct structural clusters.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a categorical grouping that can be used to partition the search space or weight distances differently within distinct structural families.

features.name: outlier_severity_score
features.description: A semantic score evaluating how anomalous the molecule's descriptor values are compared to the typical training set distribution.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the KNN model to dynamically adjust neighborhood sizes or distance weights for samples that lie far from the main data manifold.
